frames.title: Both Owners: Marketing Truth and Strategy
frames.on_screen:
Both Owners
Your Truth

So, to get ANY business off the ground, you NEED marketing.
And outsourcing the #1 source of revenue in your business at this stage... Is DUMB
And it's DUMB because learning how to RUN the ads is SO simple.
What's hard is actually CREATING the ads that make the platforms work.
So in order to scale your business to $100k/month you don't need Facebook Ads...
You need a MARKETING STRATEGY.

frames.title: Agency Route Options: Hungry, Mill/Mid, Premium
frames.on_screen:
Agency Route
Your Options

Here are your options:
1. Invest into a Hungry agency ($1.5k-$4k)
Pro: They are extremely driven to help you & learn
Con: They watched the same YouTube videos you did.

2. Invest into a Mill/Mid agency ($4k-$7k)
Pro: They are great at meeting deliverables
Con: You are just 1 of dozens of client plug into a machine

3. Invest into a Premium agency ($7k-$10k+ per month)
Pro: They are you best chance of success
Con: They won't work with you/you will run out of money

frames.title: Individual Route Options: Media Buyer, Strategist, In-House
frames.on_screen:
Individual Route
Your Options

Here are your options:
1. Hire a freelance media buyer ($500-$1,000 per month)
Pro: They click buttons for you
Con: They are only clicking buttons, they can't drive performance

2. Hire a freelancer creative strategist ($1,500-$2,500 per month)
Pro: Cheap
Con: Cares more about their own freedom than your business.

3. Hire someone in house ($3k-$5k+ per month)
Pro: They are committed to your business
Con: Savages don't work with beginners/You don't know how to manage a marketer.

frames.title: Hiring a Video Editor: Strategy and Key Points
frames.on_screen:
One Creative
The Strategy

Key Points For Hiring
- Step 1: Interview at least 20 people (most of you will do 10)
- Step 2: The best interviews, send them a mini assessment (an ad brief)
- Step 3: Process the assessment & hire the highest skilled & most driven (ideally full time if not by the hour)
- Step 4: Onboard the video editor by showing them everything about your brand
- Step 5: Meet with them weekly to discuss ideas, complete feedback loops on the ad

Key points:
- Pay Editors $10-$25/hour
- Give them an incentive (5% of ad spend) or ($100 for every winning ad)
- Setup direct communication on Discord or Slack
- Set CLEAR expectations that you want WINNING ads & define what a winning ad is & focus on THAT. Sell the vision of growth (our video editor story)
- The #1 marketing hire EVERYONE should make is a content creator, #2 is a video editor
